title.zh: 卷二 本紀第二: 太祖下
title.raw: 卷二 本紀第二: 太祖下 Volume 2 Annals 2: Taizu 2

sentences.zh: 太祖下

translations.literal: Taizu, Part Two
translations.idiomatic: Taizu, Part Two

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙申，射虎東山。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, on bingchen day in the first month of spring, he hunted tigers on Eastern Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on bingchen day in the first month of spring, he hunted tigers on Eastern Mountain.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，修遼陽故城，以漢民、渤海戶實之，改為東平郡，置防禦使。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingyin day, he restored the old city of Liaoyang, filled it with Han and Bohai households, renamed it Dongping Commandery, and established a Defense Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingyin day, he rebuilt the old city of Liaoyang, settled it with Han and Bohai households, renamed it Dongping Commandery, and appointed a Defense Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚辰，至自東平郡。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on gengchen day, he returned from Dongping Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on gengchen day, he returned from Dongping Commandery.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁酉，謁孔子廟，命皇后、皇太子分謁寺觀。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on dingyou day, he visited Confucius's temple and ordered the Empress and Crown Prince each to visit temples and monasteries separately.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on dingyou day, he paid homage at Confucius's temple and ordered the Empress and Crown Prince to visit temples and monasteries in turn.

sentences.zh: 九月，征烏古部，道聞皇太后不豫，一日馳六百里還，侍太后，病間，復還軍中。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, while campaigning against the Wugu tribe, he heard on the road that the Empress Dowager was ill; in one day he rode six hundred li back, attended the Empress Dowager, and after her illness abated, returned to the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, while marching against the Wugu tribe, he learned on the road that the Empress Dowager was ill. He rode six hundred li in a single day to attend her; when she recovered, he returned to the army.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，次烏古部，天大風雪，兵不能進，上禱於天，俄頃而霽。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on bingwu day, he halted among the Wugu; a great wind and snowstorm blew, and the army could not advance; the Emperor prayed to Heaven, and in a moment the sky cleared.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on bingwu day, he encamped among the Wugu. A fierce blizzard blocked the army's advance; the Emperor prayed to Heaven, and within moments the sky cleared.

sentences.zh: 命皇太子將先鋒軍進擊，破之，俘獲生口萬四千二百，牛馬、車乘、廬帳、器物二十餘萬。

translations.literal: He ordered the Crown Prince to lead the vanguard in attack; they broke the enemy and took fourteen thousand two hundred captives, and more than two hundred thousand oxen, horses, carts, tents, and implements.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the Crown Prince to lead the vanguard forward; they routed the enemy, taking fourteen thousand two hundred captives and more than two hundred thousand oxen, horses, carts, tents, and goods.

sentences.zh: 自是舉部來附。

translations.literal: From this time the whole tribe came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: From that time the entire tribe submitted.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙丑，始制契丹大字。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, on yichou day in the first month of spring, he first devised the Khitan large script.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on yichou day in the first month of spring, he first created the Khitan large script.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙寅，吳越王復遣滕彥休貢犀角、珊瑚，授官以遣。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on bingyin day, the King of Wuyue again sent Teng Yanxiu with tribute of rhinoceros horn and coral; offices were conferred on him and he was sent away.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on bingyin day, the King of Wuyue again dispatched Teng Yanxiu with rhinoceros horn and coral as tribute; he was granted an office and sent home.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，有龍見於拽剌山陽水上，上射獲之，藏其骨內府。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, a dragon was seen in the waters south of Zhaila Mountain; the Emperor shot and captured it and stored its bones in the imperial vault.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day a dragon appeared in the waters south of Zhaila Mountain; the Emperor shot and killed it and had its bones stored in the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 閏六月丁卯，以皇弟蘇為惕隱，康默記為夷離畢。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month, on dingmao day, his younger brother Su was made tixin, and Kang Moj was made yilijin bil.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, on dingmao day, his younger brother Su was made tixin, and Kang Moj was made yilijin bil.

sentences.zh: 秋八月己未朔，項諸部叛。

translations.literal: On the jiwei new moon in the eighth month of autumn, the Xiang tribes rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei new moon in the eighth month of autumn, the Xiang tribes rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上親征。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, the Emperor personally led a campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Emperor took the field in person.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑朔，梁遣郎公遠來聘。

translations.literal: On the jichou new moon in the ninth month, Liang sent Lang Gongyuan on a diplomatic mission.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou new moon in the ninth month, Liang dispatched Lang Gongyuan on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大字成，詔頒行之。

translations.literal: On renyin day, the large script was completed and an edict ordered its promulgation.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the large script was finished, and an edict ordered it promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 皇太子率迭剌部夷離汙裏軫等略地雲內、天德。

translations.literal: The Crown Prince led Diela branch chiefs including Wuli Zhen and others on raids through Yunnei and Tiande.
translations.idiomatic: The Crown Prince led Diela branch chiefs including Wuli Zhen and others in raids across Yunnei and Tiande.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，攻天德。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinwei day, they attacked Tiande.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on xinwei day, they attacked Tiande.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，節度使宋瑤降，賜弓矢、鞍馬、旗鼓，更其軍曰應天。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Military Governor Song Yao surrendered; he was given bow and arrows, saddle and horse, and banners and drums, and his army was renamed Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Military Governor Song Yao surrendered; he was granted bow and arrows, saddle and horse, banners and drums, and his force was renamed the Yingtian Army.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，班師。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 宋瑤復叛。

translations.literal: Song Yao rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yao rebelled once more.

sentences.zh: 丙子，撥其城，擒宋瑤，俘其家屬，徙其民於陰山南。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, they stormed the city, captured Song Yao, took his family prisoner, and moved the people south of the Yin Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day they stormed the city, seized Song Yao, took his household captive, and resettled the populace south of the Yin Mountains.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，師還。

translations.literal: On jiwei day in the twelfth month, the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day in the twelfth month the army returned.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月丙午，以皇弟蘇為南府宰相，迭裏為惕隱。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, on bingwu day in the first month of spring, his younger brother Su was made Southern Chancellor, and Dieli was made tixin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on bingwu day in the first month of spring, his younger brother Su was made Southern Chancellor, and Dieli was made tixin.

sentences.zh: 南府宰相，自諸弟構亂，府之名族多罹其禍，故其位久虛，以鋤得部轄得裏、只裏古攝之。

translations.literal: The Southern Chancellor post had been vacant for a long time since the chaos among the brothers, which had brought calamity to many leading families of the prefecture, so Chiefs of the Chudem tribe Zagdeli and Zhiligu had been overseeing it.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Chancellorship had long stood empty: after the brothers' rebellion had ruined many great families of the prefecture, Zagdeli and Zhiligu of the Chudem tribe had held the office in trust.

sentences.zh: 府中數請擇任宗室，上以舊制不可輒變；

translations.literal: The prefecture repeatedly requested selecting someone from the imperial clan, but the Emperor said the old system could not be rashly changed.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture repeatedly petitioned that a member of the imperial clan be chosen, but the Emperor held that the old institution must not be altered lightly.

sentences.zh: 請不已，乃告於宗廟而後授之。

translations.literal: When the petitions continued without cease, he reported to the ancestral temple before conferring the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: When the petitions would not cease, he announced the matter at the ancestral temple before granting the appointment.

sentences.zh: 宗室為南府宰相自此始。

translations.literal: Imperial clan members as Southern Chancellor began from this time.
translations.idiomatic: From this time members of the imperial clan served as Southern Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙戌朔，詔定法律，正班爵。

translations.literal: On the bingxu new moon in the fifth month of summer, an edict fixed the laws and regularized court ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon in the fifth month of summer, an edict established the laws and set court ranks in order.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔畫前代直臣像為招諫圖，及詔長吏四孟月詢民利病。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, an edict ordered portraits of upright ministers of past dynasties painted as the Recruitment for Remonstrance chart, and that prefectural officials in each of the four seasonal months inquire into the people's welfare and ills.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict ordered portraits of upright ministers of former ages painted as the Recruitment for Remonstrance chart, and that local officials in each of the four seasonal months inquire into the people's hardships and needs.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the yimao new moon in the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao new moon in the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑朔，晉新州防禦使王鬱以所部山北兵馬內附。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the guichou new moon, Wang Yu, Defense Commissioner of Jin's Xinzhou, submitted with his armies and horses from north of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, on the guichou new moon of the tenth month, Wang Yu, Defense Commissioner of Jin's Xinzhou, defected with his troops and horses from north of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上率大軍入居庸關。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, the Emperor led a great army through Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Emperor led a great army through Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，下古北口。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guimao day, they descended through the ancient northern pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guimao day, they passed down through the ancient northern gate.

sentences.zh: 丁未，分兵略檀、順、安遠、三河、良鄉、望都、潞、滿城、遂城等十餘城，俘其民徙內地。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, detachments were sent to raid more than ten cities including Tan, Shun, Anyuan, Sanhe, Liangxiang, Wangdu, Lu, Mancheng, Suicheng, and others; captives were taken and the people moved into the interior.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day detachments were sent to overrun more than ten cities—Tan, Shun, Anyuan, Sanhe, Liangxiang, Wangdu, Lu, Mancheng, Suicheng, and others—taking captives and resettling the people in the interior.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，王鬱率其眾來朝，上呼鬱為子，賞賚甚厚，而徙其眾于潢水之南。

translations.literal: On guichou day in the twelfth month, Wang Yu came to court with his followers; the Emperor called Yu "son," rewarded him lavishly, and moved his people south of the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day in the twelfth month Wang Yu came to court with his followers; the Emperor called him "son," heaped gifts upon him, and resettled his people south of the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 庚申，皇太子率王郁略地定州，康默記攻長蘆。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, the Crown Prince led Wang Yu on raids in Dingzhou, while Kang Moj attacked Changlu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Crown Prince led Wang Yu in raids around Dingzhou, while Kang Moj attacked Changlu.

sentences.zh: 唐義武軍節度使王處直養子都囚其父，<一>自稱留後。

translations.literal: Wang Chuzhi, Military Governor of Tang's Yiwu Army, was imprisoned by his adopted son Du, who <1> proclaimed himself acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chuzhi, Military Governor of Tang's Yiwu Army, was imprisoned by his adopted son Du, who <1> declared himself acting governor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，圍涿州，有白兔緣壘而上，是日破其郛。

translations.literal: On guihai day, they besieged Zhuozhou; a white hare climbed the ramparts, and that day they broke the outer city.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day they besieged Zhuozhou; a white hare scaled the walls, and that same day they stormed the outer city.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，刺史李嗣弼以城降。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Prefect Li Sibi surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Prefect Li Sibi surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，存至定州，王都迎謁馬前。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Li Cun reached Dingzhou, and Wang Du came out to greet him before his horse.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Li Cun reached Dingzhou, and Wang Du came out to greet him at his horse's head.

sentences.zh: 存引兵趨望都，遇我軍禿餒五千騎，圍之，存力戰數四，不解。

translations.literal: Cun marched toward Wangdu, encountered five thousand of our cavalry weakened by hunger, surrounded them, fought fiercely four times, but could not break free.
translations.idiomatic: Cun pressed toward Wangdu and met five thousand of our horsemen, gaunt with hunger; he surrounded them and fought four fierce engagements but could not break the encirclement.

sentences.zh: 李嗣昭領三百騎來救，我軍少卻，存乃得出，大戰，我軍不利，引歸。

translations.literal: Li Sizhao led three hundred horsemen to the rescue; our forces briefly withdrew, and Cun was able to escape; in the great battle that followed our army was at a disadvantage and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sizhao led three hundred horsemen to the rescue; our forces fell back slightly, and Cun broke free; in the great battle that followed our army was worsted and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 存至幽州，遣二百騎躡我軍後，我軍反擊，悉擒之。

translations.literal: When Cun reached Youzhou, he sent two hundred horsemen to follow our army; we counterattacked and captured them all.
translations.idiomatic: When Cun reached Youzhou he sent two hundred horsemen to trail our army; we turned and struck, capturing every man.

sentences.zh: 己卯，還次檀州，幽人來襲，擊走之，擒其裨將。

translations.literal: On jimao day, returning we halted at Tanzhou; men from You came to attack; we drove them off and captured their assistant general.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, on the return march we halted at Tanzhou; men from You came to attack; we drove them off and took their assistant general prisoner.

sentences.zh: 詔徙檀、順民于東平、瀋州。

translations.literal: An edict moved the people of Tan and Shun to Dongping and Shen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict resettled the people of Tan and Shun in Dongping and Shen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 天贊元年春二月庚申，復徇幽、薊地。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianzan, on gengshen day in the second month of spring, he again raided the You and Ji region.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianzan, on gengshen day in the second month of spring, he again overran the You and Ji region.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔改元，赦軍前殊死以下。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, an edict changed the era name and pardoned offenses below capital crimes committed before the army.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict changed the era name and granted amnesty for offenses short of capital crimes to all who had marched with the army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，攻薊州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin day, they attacked Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin day, they attacked Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，撥之，擒刺史胡瓊，以盧國用、涅魯古典軍民事。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, they stormed it, captured Prefect Hu Qiong, and put Lu Guoyong and Nielu Gu in charge of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day they stormed it, took Prefect Hu Qiong prisoner, and put Lu Guoyong and Nielu Gu in charge of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大饗軍士。

translations.literal: On renxu day, he feasted the soldiers on a grand scale.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day he held a great feast for the troops.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，李存圍鎮州，張文禮求援，命郎君迭烈、將軍康末怛往擊，敗之，殺其將李嗣昭。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Li Cun besieged Zhenzhou; Zhang Wenli requested aid, and Langjun Dielie and General Kang Modan were sent to strike them, defeated them, and killed their general Li Sizhao.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Li Cun besieged Zhenzhou; Zhang Wenli sought relief, and Langjun Dielie and General Kang Modan were dispatched against him; they routed the enemy and killed their general Li Sizhao.

sentences.zh: 辛未，攻石城縣，撥之。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, they attacked Shicheng County and stormed it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day they attacked Shicheng County and took it by storm.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，張文禮卒，其子處瑾遣人奉表來謝。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingwei day, Zhang Wenli died; his son Chujin sent envoys bearing a memorial of thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingwei day, Zhang Wenli died; his son Chujin sent envoys with a memorial of gratitude.

sentences.zh: 六月，遣鷹軍擊西南諸部，以所獲賜貧民。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Eagle Army was dispatched to attack tribes in the southwest; the captives taken were given to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Eagle Army was sent against tribes in the southwest; the captives taken were distributed to the poor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，以蕭霞的為北府宰相。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiazi day, Xiao Xiade was made Northern Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on jiazi day, Xiao Xiade was made Northern Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 分迭剌部為二院：斜涅赤為北院夷離，綰思為南院夷離，詔分北大濃兀為二部，立兩節度使以統之。

translations.literal: The Diela tribe was divided into two divisions: Xie Niechi was made Northern Division yilijin, Wansi was made Southern Division yilijin; an edict split the Great Northern Nongwu into two tribes and established two Military Governors to command them.
translations.idiomatic: The Diela tribe was divided into two divisions: Xie Niechi was made Northern Division yilijin and Wansi Southern Division yilijin; an edict split the Great Northern Nongwu into two tribes and set two Military Governors over them.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，命皇子堯骨為天下兵馬大元帥，略地薊北。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renyin day, the Emperor appointed Prince Yaogu Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses to raid north of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renyin day, the Emperor named Prince Yaogu Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses and sent him to overrun the country north of Ji.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙申，大元帥堯骨克平州，獲刺史趙思溫、裨將張崇。

translations.literal: In the second year, on bingchen day in the first month of spring, Grand Marshal Yaogu captured Pingzhou, taking Prefect Zhao Siwen and Assistant General Zhang Chong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on bingchen day in the first month of spring, Grand Marshal Yaogu took Pingzhou, capturing Prefect Zhao Siwen and Assistant General Zhang Chong.

sentences.zh: 二月，如平州。

translations.literal: In the second month, he went to Pingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he proceeded to Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以平州為盧龍軍，置節度使。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Pingzhou was made the Lulong Army and a Military Governor was installed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Pingzhou was made the Lulong Army and a Military Governor was appointed.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，軍於箭山，討叛奚胡損，獲之，射以鬼箭。

translations.literal: On wuyin day in the third month, the army camped at Arrow Mountain to campaign against the rebel Xi chief Husun; he was captured and shot with ghost arrows.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day in the third month the army encamped at Arrow Mountain to suppress the rebel Xi chief Husun; he was taken and executed with ghost arrows.

sentences.zh: 誅其黨三百人，沉之狗河。

translations.literal: Three hundred of his followers were executed and thrown into Gou River.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred of his followers were put to death and cast into Gou River.

sentences.zh: 置奚墮瑰部，以勃魯恩權總其事。

translations.literal: The Xi Duigui tribe was established, with Boluen appointed to oversee its affairs on a provisional basis.
translations.idiomatic: The Xi Duigui tribe was established, with Boluen provisionally placed in overall charge.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，梁遣使來聘，吳越王遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou day, Liang sent envoys on a diplomatic mission, and the King of Wuyue sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou day, Liang sent envoys on a diplomatic visit, and the King of Wuyue sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命堯骨攻幽州，迭剌部夷離覿烈徇山西地。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Yaogu was ordered to attack Youzhou, and Diela branch yilijin Dilie raided Shanxi territory.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Yaogu was ordered to attack Youzhou, while Diela branch yilijin Dilie overran the Shanxi region.

sentences.zh: 庚申，堯骨軍幽州東，節度使符存審遣人出戰，敗之，擒其將裴信父子。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Yaogu's army reached east of Youzhou; Military Governor Fu Cunshen sent men out to fight; they were defeated, and General Pei Xin and his son were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Yaogu's army reached east of Youzhou; Military Governor Fu Cunshen sent troops out to give battle; they were beaten, and General Pei Xin and his son were taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚辰，堯骨抵鎮州。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on gengchen day, Yaogu reached Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengchen day, Yaogu reached Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，撥曲陽。

translations.literal: On renwu day, they stormed Quyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day they stormed Quyang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，下北平。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, they captured Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day they took Beiping.

sentences.zh: 是月，晉王李存即皇帝位，國號唐。

translations.literal: That month, Jin King Li Cun assumed the imperial throne and took Tang as his dynastic name.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jin King Li Cun ascended the throne and proclaimed the dynastic name Tang.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，堯骨師還。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wuwu day, Yaogu's army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuwu day, Yaogu's army returned.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，大饗軍士，賞賚有差。

translations.literal: On guihai day, he feasted the soldiers on a grand scale, with rewards in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day he held a great feast for the troops, distributing rewards in due measure.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，波斯國來貢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinchou day, Persia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinchou day, Persia sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，前北府宰相蕭阿古只及王郁徇地燕、趙。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, former Northern Chancellor Xiao Aguzhi and Wang Yu raided the Yan and Zhao region.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn former Northern Chancellor Xiao Aguzhi and Wang Yu overran the Yan and Zhao region.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the xinwei new moon in the tenth month of winter, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei new moon in the tenth month of winter there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己卯，唐兵滅梁。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Tang forces destroyed Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Tang forces destroyed Liang.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月，遣兵略地燕南。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the first month of spring, troops were dispatched to raid south of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the first month of spring, troops were sent to overrun the country south of Yan.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙午，以惕隱迭裏為南院夷離。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on bingwu day, tixin Dieli was made Southern Division yilijin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on bingwu day, tixin Dieli was made Southern Division yilijin.

sentences.zh: 是月，徙薊州民實遼州地。

translations.literal: That month, the people of Jizhou were moved to populate Liaozhou territory.
translations.idiomatic: That month the people of Jizhou were resettled to fill Liaozhou territory.

sentences.zh: 渤海殺其刺史張秀實而掠其民。

translations.literal: Bohai killed its prefect Zhang Xiushi and plundered its people.
translations.idiomatic: Bohai killed its prefect Zhang Xiushi and carried off its people.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，召皇后、皇太子、大元帥及二宰相、諸部頭等詔曰；

translations.literal: On yiyou day in the sixth month, the Emperor summoned the Empress, Crown Prince, Grand Marshal, the two Chancellors, and chiefs of the various tribes and addressed an edict, saying:
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the sixth month the Emperor summoned the Empress, Crown Prince, Grand Marshal, the two Chancellors, and chiefs of the various tribes and proclaimed an edict, saying:

sentences.zh: 「上天降監，惠及民。

translations.literal: "Heaven above sends its watch, blessing the people.
translations.idiomatic: "Heaven above keeps watch and bestows its grace upon the people.

sentences.zh: 聖主明王，萬載一遇。

translations.literal: A sage sovereign and enlightened king — once in ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: A sage sovereign and enlightened king comes but once in ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 朕既上承天命，下統群生，每有征行，皆奉天意。

translations.literal: I have received Heaven's mandate above and rule all living beings below; in every campaign I follow Heaven's will.
translations.idiomatic: I have received Heaven's mandate above and govern all living beings below; in every campaign I act in accord with Heaven's intent.

sentences.zh: 是以機謀在己，取捨如神，國令既行，人情大附。

translations.literal: Therefore strategy rests in my own hand, and what I take or leave is as if divinely ordered; once the nation's commands are issued, hearts everywhere attach.
translations.idiomatic: Thus strategy rests in my own hand, and what I choose or set aside is decided as by a god; once the nation's commands go forth, the people's hearts rally to me.

sentences.zh: 舛訛歸正，遐邇無愆。

translations.literal: Errors are set right, and far and near alike are without fault.
translations.idiomatic: Wrong is made right, and far and near alike stand without reproach.

sentences.zh: 可謂大含溟海，安納泰山矣！

translations.literal: One may say I embrace the breadth of the dark sea and hold steady as Mount Tai!
translations.idiomatic: Truly I may be said to hold within me the vast dark sea and stand firm as Mount Tai!

sentences.zh: 自我國之經營，為群方之父母。

translations.literal: Since founding our state, we have been parent to all regions.
translations.idiomatic: From the founding of our state we have been parent to every quarter.

sentences.zh: 憲章斯在，胤嗣何憂？

translations.literal: With law and charter established, what worry for heirs?
translations.idiomatic: With law and charter in place, what need to fear for heirs?

sentences.zh: 升降有期，去來在我。

translations.literal: Ascent and descent have their appointed time; coming and going lie in my hand.
translations.idiomatic: Rising and falling have their appointed season; departure and return rest in my hand.

sentences.zh: 良籌聖會，自有契於天人；

translations.literal: A wise plan and sacred assembly — surely there is accord between Heaven and man;
translations.idiomatic: A wise design and a sacred convergence — surely Heaven and man are already in accord;

sentences.zh: 眾國群王，豈可化其凡骨？

translations.literal: the kings of many lands — could they transform their common bones?
translations.idiomatic: the kings of many lands — can they alter bones of common clay?

sentences.zh: 三年之後，歲在丙戌，時值初秋，必有歸處。

translations.literal: Three years hence, in the year bingxu, at the start of autumn, there will surely be a place of return.
translations.idiomatic: Three years hence, in the bingxu year, at the opening of autumn, there will surely be a place to which I return.

sentences.zh: 然未終兩事，豈負親誠？

translations.literal: Yet have I not fulfilled two undertakings — could I fail the sincerity of kin?
translations.idiomatic: Yet two tasks remain unfinished — how could I betray the sincerity of kin?

sentences.zh: 日月非遙，戒嚴是速。

translations.literal: The sun and moon are not far; let preparations be swift.
translations.idiomatic: The sun and moon are not distant; let preparations be made in haste.

sentences.zh: 」聞詔者皆驚懼，莫識其意。

translations.literal: " All who heard the edict were alarmed and afraid, and none understood its meaning.
translations.idiomatic: " All who heard the edict were struck with fear, and none could fathom its meaning.

sentences.zh: 是日，大舉征吐渾、項、阻卜等部。

translations.literal: That day, a great campaign was launched against the Tuyuhun, Xiang, Zubu, and other tribes.
translations.idiomatic: That same day a great campaign was launched against the Tuyuhun, Xiang, Zubu, and other tribes.

sentences.zh: 詔皇太子監國，大元帥堯骨從行。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Crown Prince to oversee the realm; Great Marshal Yaogu accompanied the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the Crown Prince to govern in his stead and took Great Marshal Yaogu with him on the march.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，曷剌等擊素昆那山東部族，破之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinhai day, Hela and others attacked the eastern tribes of Sukunna Mountain and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, on xinhai day, Hela and his officers struck the eastern clans of Sukunna Mountain and broke them.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，至烏孤山，以鵝祭天。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yiyou day, they reached Wugu Mountain and sacrificed geese to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou day, the army came to Wugu Mountain and offered geese to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 甲午，次古單于國，登阿裏典壓得斯山，以鹿祭。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, they halted at the old Xiongnu state, ascended Mount Alidianyadesi, and sacrificed deer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day they encamped in the old Xiongnu lands, climbed Mount Alidianyadesi, and made a deer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申朔，次古回鶻城，勒石紀功。

translations.literal: On the bingshen new moon of the ninth month, they halted at the old Uighur city and inscribed a stele recording their achievements.
translations.idiomatic: At the bingshen new moon of the ninth month they stopped at the ruined Uighur capital and carved a stone to commemorate the campaign.

sentences.zh: 庚子，拜日于林。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, they performed sun-worship in the forest.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day they bowed to the sun among the trees.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣騎攻阻卜。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, cavalry was dispatched to attack the Zubu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day he sent horsemen against the Zubu.

sentences.zh: 南府宰相蘇、南院夷離迭裏略地西南。

translations.literal: Southern Chancellor Su and Southern Court yilü Dieli raided southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Chancellor Su and Southern Court yilü Dieli swept the southwest.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，蘇等獻俘。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Su and the others presented captives.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Su and his commanders brought in prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，鑿金河水，取烏山石，<三>輦致潢河、木葉山，以示山川朝海宗嶽之意。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, they cut the Golden River, took stone from Wushan, <3> had it conveyed by cart to the Huang River and Mount Muye, to express the idea that mountains and rivers pay homage to the sea and honor the sacred peaks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day they opened a channel in the Golden River, quarried stone from Wushan, <3> and had it carted to the Huang River and Mount Muye—signifying that every river and ridge bows toward the sea and every peak pays court to the sacred mountains.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，大食國來貢。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the Da Shi lands sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day envoys arrived from the Arab lands with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔礱辟遏可汗故碑，以契丹、突厥、漢字紀其功。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, an edict ordered that the old stele of Khan Longbiye be re-carved, recording his achievements in Khitan, Turkic, and Chinese scripts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day he decreed that the old stele of Khan Longbiye be cut anew, its deeds inscribed in Khitan, Turkic, and Chinese.

sentences.zh: 是月，破胡母思山諸蕃部，次業得思山，以赤牛青馬祭天地。

translations.literal: That month they defeated the various barbarian tribes of Hmusin Mountain, halted at Yedesi Mountain, and sacrificed red oxen and blue horses to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: That month they overran the tribal settlements on Hmusin Mountain, camped at Yedesi Mountain, and offered red oxen and blue horses to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 回鶻霸裏遣使來貢。

translations.literal: The Uighur Boli sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Boli of the Uighurs dispatched envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅朔，獵寓樂山，獲野獸數千，以充軍食。

translations.literal: On the bingyin new moon of the tenth winter month, they hunted at Mount Yule, capturing several thousand wild beasts to supply the army's food.
translations.idiomatic: At the bingyin new moon of the tenth winter month they hunted on Mount Yule, taking several thousand head of game to feed the host.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，軍於霸離思山。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the army encamped at Mount Balisi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the army halted on Mount Balisi.

sentences.zh: 遣兵流沙，撥浮圖城，盡取西鄙諸部。

translations.literal: Troops were dispatched across the desert sands; they stormed Fotu City and took all the western border tribes.
translations.idiomatic: He sent soldiers across the drifting sands, stormed Fotu City, and brought every tribe on the western marches to heel.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未朔，獲甘州回鶻都督畢離遏，因遣使諭其主烏母主可汗。

translations.literal: On the yimao new moon of the eleventh month, they captured Bilie'e, military commissioner of the Ganzhou Uighurs, and then sent envoys to instruct his lord, Khan Wumu.
translations.idiomatic: At the yimao new moon of the eleventh month they seized Bilie'e, the Ganzhou Uighur commissioner, and sent envoys to deliver their terms to his sovereign, Khan Wumu.

sentences.zh: 射虎于烏剌邪裏山，抵霸室山。

translations.literal: They hunted tigers at Mount Wulaxieli and reached Mount Bashishi.
translations.idiomatic: They hunted tiger on Mount Wulaxieli and pressed on to Mount Bashishi.

sentences.zh: 六百餘里且行且獵，日有鮮食，軍士皆給。

translations.literal: For more than six hundred li they marched and hunted by turns; fresh meat came every day, and every soldier was fed.
translations.idiomatic: For six hundred li and more they alternated march and hunt; fresh meat came every day, and no man in the ranks went hungry.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬寅，以捷報皇后、皇太子。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, on renyin day in the first month, victory was announced to the Empress and Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year, on renyin day in the first month, word of triumph was sent to the Empress and Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，大元帥堯骨略項。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingyin day, Great Marshal Yaogu raided the Xi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingyin day, Great Marshal Yaogu harried the Xi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，皇后遣康末怛問起居，進御服、酒膳。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the Empress sent Kang Moda to inquire after his health and forwarded imperial robes, wine, and provisions.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Empress sent Kang Moda to ask after his welfare and forwarded court robes, wine, and a full table.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，蕭阿古只略燕、趙還，進牙旗兵仗。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Xiao Aguzhi returned from raiding Yan and Zhao and presented battle-flags and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Xiao Aguzhi came back from the Yan and Zhao frontier with captured standards and arms.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，堯骨獻項俘。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Yaogu presented Xi captives.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Yaogu delivered Xi prisoners to court.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，饗軍于水精山。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingshen day, the army was feasted at Mount Shuijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingshen day, he held a great feast for the army at Crystal Mountain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，南攻小蕃，下之。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on jiazi day, they attacked southward a small barbarian group and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on jiazi day, he turned south against a minor tribe and brought it down.

sentences.zh: 皇后、皇太子迎謁於劄裏河。

translations.literal: The Empress and Crown Prince came to meet him at Zhali River.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress and Crown Prince rode out to greet him on the Zhali River.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，回鶻烏母主可汗遣使貢謝。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the Uighur Khan Wumu sent envoys with tribute in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Khan Wumu of the Uighurs sent envoys with gifts of thanks.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，清暑室韋北陘。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiayin day, he took cool repose at the northern pass of the Shiwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiayin day, he sought the cool of the Shiwei northern pass.

sentences.zh: 秋九月癸巳，至自西征。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, on guisi day, he returned from the western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the ninth month, on guisi day, he came home from the western war.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，唐以滅梁來告，即遣使報聘。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on dingmao day, Tang reported the destruction of Liang; envoys were at once dispatched in return courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on dingmao day, Tang announced the fall of Liang, and he immediately sent envoys in reply.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，日本國來貢。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Japan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day tribute arrived from Japan.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，高麗國來貢。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Goryeo sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Goryeo sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，幸安國寺，飯僧，赦京師囚，縱五坊鷹鶻。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingyou day, he visited Anguo Temple, fed the monks, pardoned prisoners in the capital, and released the hawks and falcons of the Five Wards.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingyou day, he visited Anguo Temple, feasted the monks, freed the capital's prisoners, and turned loose the hunting birds of the Five Wards.

sentences.zh: 己酉，新羅國來貢。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Silla sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Silla sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥，詔曰：「所謂兩事，一事已畢，惟渤海世讎未雪，豈宜安駐！

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yihai day, an edict declared: "Of the two matters spoken of, one is already finished; only the hereditary feud with Bohai remains unavenged—how can I remain at rest!
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yihai day, he proclaimed: "Of the two undertakings I foretold, one is complete; only the blood-debt with Bohai remains unpaid. How can I sit idle?

sentences.zh: 」乃舉兵親征渤海大 。

translations.literal: " He then raised an army and personally campaigned against Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: " At once he marshaled his host and marched in person against Bohai.

sentences.zh: 皇后、皇太子、大元帥堯骨皆從。

translations.literal: The Empress, Crown Prince, and Great Marshal Yaogu all accompanied him.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress, the Crown Prince, and Great Marshal Yaogu all went with him.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬辰，祠木葉山。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on renchen day, he sacrificed at Mount Muye.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on renchen day, he offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以青牛白馬祭天地于烏山。

translations.literal: On renyin day, with blue cattle and white horses he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at Mount Wu.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, with blue oxen and white horses, he worshipped Heaven and Earth on Mount Wu.

sentences.zh: 己酉，次撒葛山，射鬼箭。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, he halted at Mount Sage and shot ghost-arrows.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day he encamped at Mount Sage and loosed ghost-arrows against evil.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，次商嶺，夜圍扶餘府。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, he halted at Shang Ridge and by night besieged Fuyu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day he reached Shang Ridge and, that same night, invested Fuyu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，安邊、頡、南海、定理等府及諸道節度、刺史來朝，慰勞遣之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengyin day, the prefectures of Anbian, Xie, Nanhai, Dingli, and others, together with circuit military commissioners and prefects, came to court; he comforted them and dismissed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengyin day, the prefectures of Anbian, Xie, Nanhai, Dingli, and the rest, with their commissioners and prefects, came to audience; he received them with praise and sent them home.

sentences.zh: 以所獲器幣諸物賜將士。

translations.literal: The weapons, silks, and other goods taken were bestowed on officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Arms, silks, and the rest of the spoils he divided among officers and rank and file.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: On renchen day, with blue cattle and white horses he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day he again sacrificed blue oxen and white horses to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元天顯。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name was changed to Tianxian.
translations.idiomatic: He declared a general amnesty and changed the reign title to Tianxian.

sentences.zh: 以平渤海遣使報唐。

translations.literal: Because Bohai had been pacified, envoys were sent to report to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: With Bohai subdued, he dispatched envoys to inform Tang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，復幸忽汗城，閱府庫物，賜從臣有差。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, he again visited Hurhan City, inspected the treasury goods, and bestowed gifts on his followers according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day he returned to Hurhan City, reviewed the storehouses, and rewarded his followers by rank.

sentences.zh: 以奚部長勃魯恩、王鬱自回鶻、新羅、吐蕃、項、室韋、沙陀、烏古等從征有功，優加賞賚。

translations.literal: Because the Xi chieftain Boru'en, Wang Yu, and others who had joined the campaign from the Uighurs, Silla, Tibet, Xi, Shiwei, Shatuo, Wugu, and the rest had served meritoriously, they were richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: The Xi chieftain Boru'en, Wang Yu, and the allies who had marched with him from Uighur, Silla, Tibetan, Xi, Shiwei, Shatuo, and Wugu lands were singled out for lavish reward.

sentences.zh: 丙午，改渤海國為東丹，忽汗城為天福。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the Bohai state was renamed Dongdan, and Hurhan City was renamed Tianfu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day he renamed the Bohai realm Dongdan and Hurhan City Tianfu.

sentences.zh: 冊皇太子倍為人皇王以主之。

translations.literal: The Crown Prince Bei was invested as Renhuang Wang to rule it.
translations.idiomatic: He invested Crown Prince Bei as Renhuang Wang to govern the new domain.

sentences.zh: 以皇弟迭剌為左大相，渤海老相為右大相，渤海司徒大素賢為左次相，耶律羽之為右次相。

translations.literal: His younger brother Diela was made Left Grand Minister; Bohai's elder minister was made Right Grand Minister; Bohai's Minister of Works Dae Sagyeon was made Left Secondary Minister; and Yelü Yuzhi was made Right Secondary Minister.
translations.idiomatic: His brother Diela became Left Grand Minister; a senior Bohai minister took the Right Grand Ministry; Dae Sagyeon, Bohai Minister of Works, became Left Secondary Minister; and Yelü Yuzhi Right Secondary Minister.

sentences.zh: 赦其國內殊死以下。

translations.literal: Within that state, all offenses short of capital crime were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the realm he pardoned every crime short of death.

sentences.zh: 丁未，高麗、貊、鐵驪、 來貢。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Goryeo, the Mo tribes, the Iron Lili, and the Mohe and Jurchen sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day envoys arrived with tribute from Goryeo, the Mohe tribes, the Iron Lili, and the Jurchen.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，遣夷離畢康默記、左僕射韓延徽攻長嶺府。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuwu day, yilü-bi Kang Mojin and Left Vice Director Han Yanhui were dispatched to attack Changling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuwu day, he sent yilü-bi Kang Mojin and Left Vice Director Han Yanhui against Changling Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲子，祭天。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Heaven was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day he performed the rites of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，幸人皇王宮。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, he visited the Renhuang Wang's palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day he called at the Renhuang Wang's palace.

sentences.zh: 己巳，安邊、頡、定理三府叛，遣安端討之。

translations.literal: On jisi day, the three prefectures of Anbian, Xie, and Dingli rebelled; Anduan was sent to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Anbian, Xie, and Dingli rose in revolt, and he sent Anduan to put them down.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，三府平。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, the three prefectures were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the three prefectures were quiet again.

sentences.zh: 壬午，安端獻俘，誅安邊府叛帥二人。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Anduan presented captives and executed the two rebel commanders of Anbian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Anduan brought in prisoners and beheaded the two rebel leaders of Anbian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸未，宴東丹國僚佐，頒賜有差。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, he feasted the Dongdan state's officials, distributing gifts by rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day he banqueted Dongdan's ministers and gave out rewards by station.

sentences.zh: 甲申，幸天福城。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, he visited Tianfu City.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day he went to Tianfu City.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，班師，以大 舉族行

translations.literal: On yiyou day, the army withdrew; the Bohai ruler led his entire clan westward on the march.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the host turned homeward, with the Bohai king Dae Inseon leading his whole clan west on the road.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥朔，次傘子山。

translations.literal: On the dinghai new moon of the fourth summer month, they halted at Mount Sanzi.
translations.idiomatic: At the dinghai new moon of the fourth summer month they stopped at Umbrella Mountain.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，人皇王率東丹國僚屬辭。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, the Renhuang Wang led the Dongdan state's officials in taking leave.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Renhuang Wang, with Dongdan's chief ministers, came to bid farewell.

sentences.zh: 是月，唐養子李嗣源反，郭存謙弑其主存，<四>嗣源遂即位。

translations.literal: That month, Tang's adopted son Li Siyuan rebelled; Guo Cunqian killed his lord Cun, <4> and Siyuan thereupon ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Siyuan, Tang's adopted son, rose in rebellion; Guo Cunqian murdered his master Cun, <4> and Siyuan seized the throne.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，南海、定理二府復叛，大元帥堯骨討之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on xinyou day, the two prefectures of Nanhai and Dingli rebelled again; Great Marshal Yaogu was sent to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinyou day, Nanhai and Dingli rebelled once more, and Great Marshal Yaogu marched to crush them.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，二府平。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingyou day, the two prefectures were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingyou day, both prefectures were subdued.

sentences.zh: 丙午，次慎州，唐遣姚坤以國哀來告。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, they halted at Shenzhou; Tang sent Yao Kun to announce the national mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the army encamped at Shenzhou while Tang sent Yao Kun to announce the court's mourning.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，鐵州刺史衛鈞反。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen day, Wei Jun, prefect of Tiezhou, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, on bingchen day, Wei Jun, prefect of Iron Prefecture, turned rebel.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，堯骨攻撥鐵州。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Yaogu attacked and stormed Tiezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Yaogu invested and stormed Iron Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚午，東丹國左大相迭剌卒。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Diela, Left Grand Minister of Dongdan, died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Diela, Dongdan's Left Grand Minister, died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，衛送大 於皇都西，築城以居之。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Wei Jun escorted Dae Inseon, the Bohai ruler, west of the imperial capital and built a city for him to dwell in.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Wei Jun convoyed Dae Inseon, king of Bohai, to a site west of the capital and walled a town for his household.

sentences.zh: 賜 名曰烏魯古，妻曰阿裏只。

translations.literal: He was given the name Ulugu; his wife was called Aliji.
translations.idiomatic: The captive king was granted the name Ulugu; his consort was styled Aliji.

sentences.zh: 盧龍行軍司馬張崇叛，奔唐。

translations.literal: Zhang Chong, marching-army marshal of Lulong, rebelled and fled to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chong, Lulong's field marshal, rebelled and fled to Tang.

sentences.zh: <五>甲戌，次扶餘府，上不豫。

translations.literal: <5> On jiaxu day, they halted at Fuyu Prefecture; the Emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: <5> On jiaxu day the imperial train stopped at Fuyu Prefecture, and the Emperor sickened.

sentences.zh: 是夕，大星隕於幄前。

translations.literal: That evening, a great star fell before his tent.
translations.idiomatic: That night a great star plummeted before his pavilion.

sentences.zh: 辛巳平旦，子城上見黃龍繚繞，可長一里，光耀奪目，入於行宮。

translations.literal: At dawn on xinsi day, a yellow dragon was seen coiling above the inner city, about a li in length, its brilliance dazzling the eye, and it entered the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on xinsi day a yellow dragon a full li long was seen spiraling above the inner citadel, blazing so bright men could scarcely look, before it glided into the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 有紫黑氣蔽天，日乃散。

translations.literal: Purple-black vapors shrouded the sky before the sun at last dispersed them.
translations.idiomatic: Purple-black clouds swallowed the sky until the sun broke through and scattered them.

sentences.zh: 是日，上崩，年五十五。

translations.literal: That day the Emperor died, aged fifty-five.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the Emperor died. He was fifty-five.

sentences.zh: 天贊三年上所謂「丙戌秋初，必有歸處」，至是乃驗。

translations.literal: The prophecy he had made in the third year of Tianzan—"In the bingxu year, at the opening of autumn, I shall surely find my place of return"—was at last fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: The words he had spoken in the third year of Tianzan—"When the bingxu year comes and early autumn arrives, I shall have my place of return"—were fulfilled at last.

sentences.zh: 壬午，皇后稱制，權決軍國事。

translations.literal: On renwu day, the Empress assumed regency and decided military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Empress took regency and held sole authority over army and state.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，康默記等攻下長嶺府。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinmao day, Kang Mojin and the others stormed Changling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao day, Kang Mojin and his commanders took Changling Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲午，皇后奉梓宮西還。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, the Empress escorted the coffin westward on the return.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Empress bore the coffin west on the homeward march.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，堯骨討平諸州，奔赴行在。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Yaogu pacified the various prefectures and hurried to the Emperor's camp.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Yaogu settled the remaining prefectures and raced to join the mourning camp.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，人皇王倍繼至。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Renhuang Wang Bei arrived afterward.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Renhuang Wang Bei came up behind.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，南府宰相蘇薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renxu day, Southern Chancellor Su died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renxu day, Southern Chancellor Su died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，梓宮至皇都，權殯於子城西北。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the coffin reached the imperial capital and was provisionally entombed in the northwest of the inner city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the coffin entered the capital and was laid in temporary rest northwest of the inner city.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上升天皇帝，廟號太祖。

translations.literal: On jisi day, he was posthumously titled Ascendant Heaven Emperor; his temple name was Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day he was honored as Ascendant Heaven Emperor, with the temple name Taizu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，盧龍軍節度使盧國用叛，奔于唐。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, Lu Guoyong, military governor of the Lulong Army, rebelled and fled to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, Lu Guoyong, governor of the Lulong Army, rebelled and fled to Tang.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，殺南院夷離耶律迭裏、郎君耶律匹魯等。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingyin day, Southern Court yilü Yelü Dieli, gentleman Yelü Pilu, and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingyin day, Southern Court yilü Yelü Dieli, gentleman Yelü Pilu, and others were put to death.

sentences.zh: 二年八月丁酉，葬太祖皇帝于祖陵，置祖州天城軍節度使以奉陵寢。

translations.literal: In the second year, eighth month, dingyou day, Emperor Taizu was buried at Zuling; a Zuzhou Tiancheng Army military governor was established to tend the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on dingyou day of the eighth month, Taizu was interred at Zuling, and a Zuzhou Tiancheng Army governor was appointed to keep the tomb.

sentences.zh: 統和二十六年七月，進大聖大明天皇帝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe, seventh month, he was advanced to Great Sage, Great Brightness, Heavenly Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe, seventh month, his posthumous title was raised to Great Sage, Great Brightness, Heavenly Emperor.

sentences.zh: 重熙二十一年九月，加大聖大明神烈天皇帝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi, ninth month, Great Sage, Great Brightness, Divine Fierce Heavenly Emperor was added to his title.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi, ninth month, he was further styled Great Sage, Great Brightness, Divine Fierce Heavenly Emperor.

sentences.zh: 太祖所崩行宮在扶餘城西南兩河之間，後建升天殿於此，而以扶餘為黃龍府雲。

translations.literal: The traveling palace where Taizu died stood between two rivers southwest of Fuyu City; afterward the Ascent-to-Heaven Hall was built there, and Fuyu was made Huanglong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The palace where Taizu died lay between two rivers southwest of Fuyu; later the Ascent-to-Heaven Hall rose on that ground, and Fuyu became Huanglong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：遼之先，出自炎帝，世為審吉國，其可知者蓋自奇首雲。

translations.literal: The encomium states: The forebears of Liao arose from the Flame Emperor; for generations they were the Shenji state; what can be known begins, perhaps, with Qishou.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the historian praises them: Liao's ancestors sprang from the Flame Emperor; for ages they were the Shenji people; the record becomes clear, it seems, with Qishou.

sentences.zh: 奇首生都山，徙潢河之濱。

translations.literal: Qishou was born at Mount Du and moved to the banks of the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: Qishou was born on Mount Du and later settled on the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 傳至雅裏，始立制度，置官屬，刻木為契，穴地為牢。

translations.literal: Passing down to Yali, he first established institutions, appointed officials, carved wood for tallies, and dug earth for prisons.
translations.idiomatic: By Yali's time the tribe first fixed laws, set officers in place, carved wooden tallies, and dug earthen cells for prisoners.

sentences.zh: 讓阻午而不肯自立。

translations.literal: He yielded to Zuwu and would not set himself up as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: He stood aside for Zuwu and refused to proclaim himself chief.

sentences.zh: 雅裏生毗牒。

translations.literal: Yali begot Bidie.
translations.idiomatic: Yali had a son Bidie.

sentences.zh: 毗牒生領。

translations.literal: Bidie begot Ling.
translations.idiomatic: Bidie was the father of Ling.

sentences.zh: 領生耨裏思，大度寡欲，令不嚴而人化，是為肅祖。

translations.literal: Ling begot Noulisi, who was magnanimous and few in desires; his orders were not strict yet the people were transformed—he is known as Emperor Suzu.
translations.idiomatic: Ling's son Noulisi was broad-minded and sparing in wants; though his rule was mild, the people were naturally swayed—this was Emperor Suzu.

sentences.zh: 肅祖生薩剌德，嘗與黃室韋挑戰，矢貫數劄，是為懿祖。

translations.literal: Suzu begot Salade, who once fought the Yellow Shiwei in battle; arrows pierced through several quivers—he is known as Emperor Yizu.
translations.idiomatic: Suzu had Salade, who once duelled the Yellow Shiwei; arrows ran through stack upon stack of quivers—this was Emperor Yizu.

sentences.zh: 懿祖生勻德實，始教民稼穡，善畜牧，國以殷富，是為玄祖。

translations.literal: Yizu begot Jundeshi, who first taught the people agriculture, excelled at animal husbandry, and the state grew rich—he is known as Emperor Xuanzu.
translations.idiomatic: Yizu begot Jundeshi, who first taught grain-growing, kept fine herds, and made the country wealthy—this was Emperor Xuanzu.

sentences.zh: 玄祖生撒剌的，仁民愛物，始置鐵冶，教民鼓鑄，是為德祖，即太祖之父也。

translations.literal: Xuanzu begot Saladi, who loved the people and cherished things, first established ironworks, and taught people smelting and casting—he is known as Emperor Dezu, Taizu's father.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzu had Saladi, humane toward the people and tender toward things; he founded ironworks and taught folk to smelt and cast—this was Emperor Dezu, father of Taizu.

sentences.zh: 世為契丹遙輦氏之夷離，執其政柄。

translations.literal: For generations they served as yilijin of the Khitan Yaolian clan, holding governmental power.
translations.idiomatic: For generations they held the yilijinship of the Khitan Yaolian line and wielded the reins of power.

sentences.zh: 德祖之弟述瀾，北征於厥、室韋，南略易、定、奚、，始興板築，置城邑，教民種桑麻，習織組，己有廣土眾民之志。

translations.literal: Dezu's younger brother Shuluo campaigned north against the Jue and Shiwei, raided south into Yi, Ding, and Xi; he first promoted rammed-earth construction, established towns, taught people to plant mulberry and hemp and practice weaving—already harboring ambitions for broad territory and a large population.
translations.idiomatic: Dezu's brother Shuluo marched north against the Jue and Shiwei and south against Yi, Ding, and Xi; he introduced rammed-earth building, founded towns, taught mulberry and hemp planting and weaving—the ambition for broad lands and a populous realm was already plain.

sentences.zh: 而太祖受可汗之禪，遂建國。

translations.literal: Then Taizu received the khan's abdication in his favor and thereupon founded the state.
translations.idiomatic: Then Taizu received the khan's surrender of the throne and founded the kingdom.

sentences.zh: 東征西討，如折枯拉朽。

translations.literal: Campaigning east and west, like snapping withered stalks and pulling rotten wood.
translations.idiomatic: East and west his campaigns went, snapping dry wood and pulling rotten timber.

sentences.zh: 東自海，西至於流沙，北絕大漠，信威萬里，歷年二百，豈一日之故哉！

translations.literal: East from the sea, west to the drifting sands, north cutting across the great desert—trust and majesty for ten thousand li, two hundred years in duration—could this be the work of a single day!
translations.idiomatic: From the eastern sea to the western wastes, from the northern desert to ten thousand li of sway—a realm two centuries in the making: was that the work of a single day?

sentences.zh: 周公誅管、蔡，人未有能非之者。

translations.literal: When the Duke of Zhou executed Guan and Cai, none could find fault with him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Duke of Zhou put Guan and Cai to death, no one faulted him for it.

sentences.zh: 剌葛、安端之亂，太祖既貸其死而復用之，非人君之度乎？

translations.literal: In the rebellion of Gege and Anduan, Taizu spared their lives and then employed them again—is this not beyond the measure of a ruler?
translations.idiomatic: In the rebellions of Gege and Anduan, Taizu spared them and then put them back in office—was that truly the measure of a prince?

sentences.zh: 舊史扶餘之變，亦異矣夫！

translations.literal: The old histories' account of the Fuyu affair is also strange indeed!
translations.idiomatic: How strange too is the old histories' tale of the Fuyu crisis!

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation Notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation Notes

sentences.zh: 一：唐義武軍節度使王處直唐，原誤「晉」。

translations.literal: 1: "Tang military governor of the Yiwu Army Wang Chuzhi Tang" — the original erroneously read "Jin."
translations.idiomatic: 1: Tang's military governor of the Yiwu Army, Wang Chuzhi — for Tang, the original text wrongly read Jin.

sentences.zh: 據卷七五王鬱傳、舊五代史五四及司馬光資治通鑒

translations.literal: According to juan 75 Biography of Wang Yu, Old History of the Five Dynasties juan 54, and Sima Guang's Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government
translations.idiomatic: According to juan 75, Biography of Wang Yu; Old History of the Five Dynasties, juan 54; and Sima Guang's Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government

sentences.zh: （以下稱通鑒）〉

translations.literal: (hereinafter abbreviated as Comprehensive Mirror)]〉
translations.idiomatic: (hereinafter abbreviated as Comprehensive Mirror)]〉

sentences.zh: 改。

translations.literal: Corrected accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Corrected accordingly.

sentences.zh: 二：裨將張崇張崇，新五代史四七、舊五代史八八本傳並作張希崇。

translations.literal: 2: "Adjutant general Zhang Chong Zhang Chong" — New History of the Five Dynasties juan 47 and Old History juan 88 biographies both read Zhang Xichong.
translations.idiomatic: 2: "Adjutant general Zhang Chong Zhang Chong" — New History of the Five Dynasties, juan 47, and Old History, juan 88, biographies both read Zhang Xichong.

sentences.zh: 此避天祚延禧嫌名，去「希」字。

translations.literal: This avoids the taboo name of Tianzuo's son Yenxi; the character xi was removed.
translations.idiomatic: This avoids the taboo name of Tianzuo's son Yenxi; the character xi was dropped.

sentences.zh: 三：鑿金河水取烏山石按「鑿」「取」二字互舛。

translations.literal: 3: "Dug the Jin River and took Wushan stone" — the characters for "dug" and "took" are transposed.
translations.idiomatic: 3: "Dug the Jin River and took Wushan stone" — the words dug and took are transposed.

sentences.zh: 四：郭存謙弑其主存 存謙，新五代史七三作從謙。

translations.literal: 4: "Guo Cunqian killed his lord Cun Cunqian" — New History juan 73 reads Congqian.
translations.idiomatic: 4: "Guo Cunqian killed his lord Cun Cunqian" — New History of the Five Dynasties, juan 73, reads Congqian.

sentences.zh: 五：盧龍行軍司馬張崇叛奔唐按張奔唐事，舊五代史三九及通鑒並系于天成三年

translations.literal: 5: "Lulong acting military governor Zhang Chong rebelled and fled to Tang" — regarding Zhang's flight to Tang, Old History juan 39 and Comprehensive Mirror both place it in the third year of Tiancheng
translations.idiomatic: 5: "Lulong field marshal Zhang Chong rebelled and fled to Tang" — regarding Zhang's flight to Tang, Old History of the Five Dynasties, juan 39, and Comprehensive Mirror both place the event in the third year of Tiancheng

sentences.zh: （遼天顯三年）〉

translations.literal: (Liao Tianxian year 3)]〉
translations.idiomatic: (Liao Tianxian year 3)]〉

sentences.zh: 閏八月。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: intercalary eighth month.
